messages:
Diego Martinez: Hey folks — my H‑1B stamp expires 06/15 and I need to start the renewal. What are the next steps from Redwood?
Priya Patel: Hi Diego — thanks for the heads up. Can you DM me your passport scan + current I‑94? We'll start the internal approval and confirm budget for filing fees.
Diego Martinez: Sending now. Quick Q: does Redwood cover attorney fees and premium processing for renewals?
Priya Patel: Policy: company covers standard attorney fees and USCIS filing fees. Premium processing is approved on a case‑by‑case basis — we usually greenlight it if there's a risk to critical deliverables. Please include a note about any upcoming travel or blockers.
Diego Martinez: Got it. No travel planned. Team asks for timeline — when should I expect receipt notice?
Elena Ruiz: From legal: receipt typically 2–3 weeks after filing. If we do premium processing, we get adjudication in ~15 calendar days. I'll loop in LegalBot for a formal intake.
LegalBot: @Elena Ruiz: Submitted intake form for Diego (case ID LGL‑2024‑1187). Please attach the signed G28 and latest offer letter. See checklist: 
```
- Signed G28 (retainer)
- Employer letter (signed by hiring manager)
- Pay stubs (last 3 months)
- Passport scan
- I-94 and visa stamp photos
- Educational docs if needed
```
Samir Gupta: Payroll note — once legal confirms filing, please send case ID to payroll@redwood.com. We need it to set up cost center for the petition and to avoid interruptions with benefits payroll deductions.
Priya Patel: Diego — I added your case to the People Ops queue. Can you confirm which manager should sign the employer letter? I think it's Antonio (Eng Manager) but want to be sure.
Diego Martinez: Yep Antonio works. Antonio, can you sign the employer letter when Priya posts the draft?
Antonio (via DM): +1, will sign.
Priya Patel: Action items for Diego: DM passport + I‑94 (done), confirm travel (no), sign electronic G28 when Legal sends, confirm Antonio as signer. I'll post the draft employer letter in #people-ops for signatures once legal prepares it.
Diego Martinez: Thanks — appreciate the quick help. One last: do I need to resubmit Form I‑9? I remember something about reverification.
Samir Gupta: For I‑9: if your current work authorization is expiring, we need to reverify in Section 3 (if within allowed window) or complete a new I‑9 if Section 3 is not applicable. HR will send a secure link to upload documents for I‑9 reverify.
Priya Patel: We'll coordinate the I‑9 step after legal files. Expect an email from HR@redwood.com with instructions and a 7‑day window to upload.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder posted: "Visa renewals — submit docs to People Ops 60 days before expiry to avoid processing delays." :calendar:
Diego Martinez: Awesome, thanks everyone. Please cc me on any submissions to the attorney.
Elena Ruiz: Will do. I'll bounce the employer letter to Antonio and copy you, Diego.
LegalBot: Next milestone: draft employer letter posted by 1711107200.
Priya Patel: Closing note: if premium processing is requested later, we need manager signoff + BU head approval. Keep us posted. :thumbsup:
